description: Java entity class representing a database table for storing debug events related to calculated fields in the Thingsboard platform. It maps the CalculatedFieldDebugEvent data to a SQL table, including fields like calculatedFieldId, eventEntityId, arguments, result, and error.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldDebugEventEntity
classes.description: JPA entity class for persisting CalculatedFieldDebugEvent data into SQL database, extending EventEntity and implementing BaseEntity.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity from a CalculatedFieldDebugEvent object.

methods.description: Converts the entity back to a CalculatedFieldDebugEvent data object.
